detectorId.description: Identifier of the detector this fault is about.
detectorId.title: ObjectId

faultId.description: Unique identifier of this fault report within the owning system.

faultTypeId.description: Reference to a DetectorFaultType entry in the fault catalogue.
faultTypeId.title: TypeId

supplierFaultNumber.description: Fault identifier allocated by the supplier or configuration manager for maintenance purposes, if required.

subsystemTypeId.description: Reference to a SubsystemDefinition entry: the subsystem the fault arose in.
subsystemTypeId.title: TypeId

equipmentFault.description: Whether this is an equipment fault. The fault type's catalogue category classifies the type; this flag classifies this fault.

communicationsFault.description: Whether this is a communications fault. See equipmentFault for how it relates to the catalogue category.

creationDate.description: When the fault was first raised.

lastUpdated.description: When the fault record was last modified.

clearedDate.description: When the fault was cleared. If present, the fault is historical.

status.description: Whether this fault is still active or has been cleared.

parameters.description: Values for the positional placeholders in the referenced FaultTypeDefinition's messageTemplate, in order. Rendered as text so a value carries whatever form the fault reports it in.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.
